name: Reaper Farm rfETH vault redeem without owner authorisation
summary: ReaperVaultV2 redeem(shares, receiver, owner) never verifies that the caller is owner or has the owner's share allowance, so the attacker burned arbitrary holders' rfETH shares and sent the underlying ETH to its receiver.
notes: Plain ReaperVaultV2 deployment; the 16,821-byte runtime is unchanged from creation through the exploit.

Six attacker transactions emitted 22 Withdraw events whose assets sum to exactly 60.199256562032326281 ETH. Later third-party withdrawals sent remaining assets to Reaper's rescue safe and are excluded.
